scope: Customer pricing rules, protected price consent, actual checkout, immutable quote history and campaign integration. Browser acceptance remains separate.
checks: anonymous and non-financial roles cannot manage or inspect the tariff matrix
merchant simulation cannot request another shop and other workspaces cannot target this merchant
approved offer remains the known standard fallback
a published offer cannot be changed to a zero-price sale
segment names are unique without case differences and cannot be self-created by merchants
shop segment changes require an authorized account, current version and same-workspace target
tariff proposal retries preserve one definition and reject altered payloads
unpublished rules never change a price
publication requires another authorized person and cannot cross the workspace boundary
independent publication activates the standard schedule with UTC-normalized dates
contract priority wins even when the segment price is cheaper
quantities outside a contract band fall through to the eligible segment
another shop in the same workspace cannot inherit a private contract or unassigned segment
campaign stacking remains forbidden unless the chosen rule explicitly allows it
same-scope overlapping periods and quantity bands cannot be published
null lines, zero prices, invalid quantity bands, wrong scope targets and invalid dates fail before publication
future replacement preserves the current contract until the exact effective instant
an independent immediate withdrawal can shorten an already scheduled cutoff without rewriting future replacement terms
concurrent tariff publication commits one decision exactly once
definition, assignment, publication, scheduled replacement and retirement history retain actual actors
missing, altered, other-actor and changed-quantity consent cannot create orders or reserve stock
queued cart operations bound to a different signed-in actor fail without replacing the basket
catalogue, product detail, favorites, saved cart and simulation resolve the same private contract
a published price change invalidates the previously displayed basket before any commitment
staff simulation shares the actual checkout engine but never issues order consent
an explicitly reviewed direct order commits exactly the displayed price with an immutable snapshot
price history is scoped to the actual order and private rule terms stay restricted
a wholesaler can explicitly apply the current tariff instead of submitted manual prices
later tariff changes cannot reprice an existing quote, accepted order or idempotent direct-order retry
negotiated deviations require an explicit reason and preserve expected versus proposed prices
quote revisions append immutable provenance rather than replacing earlier commercial terms
non-cumulative customer contracts suppress both basket and campaign discount previews
an explicitly selected incompatible campaign is rejected without quote or snapshot side effects
allowed campaigns use identical per-unit centime rounding in preview, basket and committed order
unknown gift stock blocks direct checkout while leaving an explicit RFQ possible
known free goods are displayed by product name and reserved through the existing custody chain
a rounded zero promotion never becomes a zero-price sale and does not prevent a quote request
gift availability includes units already requested for sale from the same physical product
